title: The Silent Shift
description: Eventually, the secret became too big to keep to myself. I started 'setting the environment' at home, dropping small hints here and there—mentioning your name a bit more often, smiling at my phone a little too much, and letting them see a version of me that was clearly in love. I wanted them to know you before they actually knew you. Slowly, the whispers started. Mothers always know first, don't they? Somehow, the dots were connected, the hints were picked up, and the secret was out in the open. There was tension, there were questions, and there were long conversations around the dining table. It wasn't always easy, but it was necessary. We moved from "Who is she?" to a moment where a decision had to be made—a decision that would change everything for us. When the heart can no longer whisper, it’s time to speak.
